$doc: Vyomi capability registry — GCP Cloud Logging. See aws/s3.json for the contract. GCP/Azure probes are not wired into test_capabilities.py's probe() yet, so every claim here leans on `tests` (run for real) rather than `probe`.

gcp.logs.explorer.title: Logs Explorer (query by resource, severity, log name, free text)

gcp.logs.analytics.title: Observability Analytics (query builder + a SQL subset over log entries)
limitations: SQL mode supports a subset of BigQuery SQL (SELECT/WHERE/ORDER BY/LIMIT over one bucket's entries) — no joins, subqueries or real BigQuery billing/slots.

gcp.logs.metrics.usage.title: Previous/month-to-date usage counters on the metrics list
limitations: Usage is the live count of stored log entries matching the metric's filter in the current/previous calendar month, not GCP's billed-bytes accounting.

gcp.logs.router.crud.title: Log Router sinks (create, list, update, delete; Cloud Storage/BigQuery/Pub/Sub/Logging bucket destinations)

gcp.logs.router.volume.title: Router volume + volume by destination type
limitations: Volume is the live count/bytes of entries each enabled sink's filter matched as they were written, not a historical GCP billing export.

gcp.logs.storage.crud.title: Log buckets (create, list, update, delete; retention, Observability Analytics / BigQuery link)
limitations: The _Default and _Required buckets are seeded automatically like real Cloud Logging projects, but cannot be deleted, matching the real API.

gcp.logs.storage.views.title: Log views on a bucket (create, list, delete)

gcp.logs.storage.usage_alerts.title: Create usage alert / View usage data (Monitoring-backed storage alerting)
limitations: Storage usage alerting hands off to Cloud Monitoring alert policies, which Vyomi's Logging lens does not model; the console shows this honestly rather than faking an alert that never fires.
